All list and detail pages (Your VPCs, Subnets, Route tables, Internet/NAT gateways, Network ACLs, Security groups) are 'reference' — recrawl list pages next. 'VPC and more' create options and NAT gateway option labels are unverified. Out-of-scope nav pages are declared by title; their routes are best-effort (confidence low).
